snippet.title: THE LIFT - Announcement Trailer | Supernatural Handyman Simulator
snippet.description:
Join Steam Playtest
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283240

You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive, immersive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and SCP Foundation. Coming to PC in 2026.

00:00 Cinematic
